checks.name: No added collider, light, runtime behaviour or unexpected component
Placement count matches report and bounded canopy plan
Canopy hierarchy is active and its frame root has identity local transform
Report lists exactly the reusable derivative mesh assets
All meshes and reused materials have stable asset identities and metas
Derivative streams, normals, bounds and indices are finite and valid
Every derivative retains the full lowest source LOD triangle topology
Live placement transforms match the authored report
All instances share the expected meshes and materials
One distance-culling LOD group owns every tree renderer
Reused canopy shaders compile and are supported
Live geometry matches the report and 520k triangle ceiling
Reported route margins are finite and consistent

scope: Validates current canopy assignments, finite geometry, source LOD topology, metas, shaders and reported placement transforms. Does not repeat global road/collider checks, prove source-file history or measure frame cost.
